hook: Voyager 1 fell silent in deep space for 48 hours, but then it woke up.

sections.voiceover: Voyager 1 fell silent in deep space for 48 hours, but then it woke up.
sections.visual_cue: Artist impression of Voyager 1 in deep space.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep space hum fading into a sharp digital ping.

sections.voiceover: On October 20, 2026, NASA lost contact with the craft. How did the team resolve this unexpected pause without sending new commands?
sections.visual_cue: NASA logo and mission control room graphics.
b_roll: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory control room

sections.voiceover: Except the team had already completed the Big Bang power-saving effort in early September.
Engineers successfully turned off 3 devices to save energy. The spacecraft stabilized itself, proving its resilience in the void of interstellar space.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing 3 devices powering down and 3 replacements powering up.

sections.voiceover: Even in the cold dark, Voyager 1 continues its long journey.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic shot of the probe moving away into a star field.
